name: 32309 · Tallahassee, FL
findings: ZIP 32309 (Tallahassee) has 162 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32309 (Tallahassee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32309 (Tallahassee) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 59 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
